baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated feminine verbs and the relation marked by لِرَبِّهَا join reception of the Lord to a state expressed by حُقَّتْ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Receptive hearing takes in an authoritative summons; lordship makes that summons binding, and the final verb marks the response as an obligation that has become due.

activation_trace.role: Attentive, accepting hearing supplies active reception rather than bare acoustic contact and serves as the intake side of the response.
Ownership and authority supply the asymmetrical relation that gives the heard demand binding force.
A fixed, owed obligation supplies due-ness and functions as the state reached through receptive response.

changed_reading.before: The feminine subject merely hears its Lord and is obligated.
changed_reading.after: The subject receives its Lord's summons with acceptance and thereby enacts or enters the binding due state named by the final verb.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The possessive Lord-relation stands between receptive hearing and a passive final verb, allowing the sequence to describe formation as well as command.
baseline_models.mechanism: The Lord is not only commander but the one who tends and completes. Receptivity permits that formative action to bring the subject into a firm, exact fit, so due-ness can be spatial and developmental as well as legal.

activation_trace.role: Accepting attention supplies responsiveness and functions as openness to being formed.
Repair, nurture, and staged completion supply a formative Lord-relation rather than authority alone.
An exactly fitted socket or container supplies the spatial image and functions as the subject's attained configuration.
Tightly made firmness supplies the material quality of the completed fit and prevents the model from being only abstract entitlement.

changed_reading.before: The sequence ends when an order is obeyed.
changed_reading.after: The sequence ends when receptive relation to the completing Lord brings the subject into its firm and proper fit.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The first verb can activate declaration as well as reception, while the Lord-relation and حُقَّتْ can carry pledged obligation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The subject's assent is heard as a self-binding ratification: it declares itself committed to the Lord's bond, and the final verb seals a reality that must be kept. This is a branch activation, not a claim that the surface verb has changed form.

activation_trace.role: Decisive self-binding declaration supplies the exploratory pledge-image and functions as voluntary ratification.
A bond or covenant supplies the relational object that the subject is imagined to ratify.
A reality whose integrity must be preserved supplies the covenant's durable content and functions as what ratification secures.

changed_reading.before: The subject is passively placed under an external requirement.
changed_reading.after: The subject's hearing also resembles assent that ratifies and preserves a binding relation, without canceling the authority reading.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding sky and its opening resolve the feminine subject and give receptive hearing a material realization. The rupture can be read not only as damage done to the sky but as the sky's own mode of answering its Lord.

activation_trace.role: Accepting hearing supplies the response category into which the preceding physical event is drawn.
Binding due-ness makes the opening an enacted requirement rather than an arbitrary fracture.
The overhead covering identifies the feminine material subject and functions as the body that answers.
Splitting into an opening supplies the concrete deformation and functions as the visible act of reception.

structural_cues: 84:1 supplies the feminine antecedent immediately before the focus ayah.
The focus coordinates reception and due-ness after the conditional opening event.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the sky, its opening, receptive hearing, and due obligation; I supply the arrow that treats opening as the enacted form of hearing. A live alternative is that the opening is imposed first and the focus reports a separate obedient reaction.

changed_reading.before: An unnamed feminine subject listens after an unspecified event.
changed_reading.after: The sky listens materially: its opening is itself a visible answer to the Lord's due claim.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact focus refrain returns after the lower world is lengthened, ejects what it contains, and becomes vacant. Reception is therefore generalized into a material operation: created bodies answer by yielding their geometry and relinquishing held contents, while vacancy also activates discharge from liability.

activation_trace.role: Receptive acceptance supplies the common label that the repeated refrain applies to unlike material actions.
Fixed obligation supplies what each material body exhausts through its mode of yielding.
The lower counterpart to the sky broadens the mechanism from one body to the vertical extremes of the created field.
Lengthwise drawing until extension supplies geometric yielding and functions as the earth's first mode of assent.
Casting a thing out supplies active ejection and functions as relinquishment of interior contents.
Vacancy and stripping bare supply the resulting empty state and complete the physical discharge.
Release from liability supplies a legal echo and lets physical emptying function as exhaustion of what was due.

structural_cues: 84:5 repeats the entire focus ayah after the earth sequence.
The sky pair and earth pair use different transformations but receive the same evaluative refrain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact repetition after extension, ejection, and vacancy; I infer that the refrain classifies those operations as listening and fulfillment. The alternative is a purely rhetorical parallel in which reception remains a separate verbal act.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes one subject's abstract obedience.
changed_reading.after: The focus is an operational refrain: matter listens by yielding its shape, releasing what it holds, and discharging its due.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same Lord-relation moves from the compliant cosmic body to the human who labors painfully toward encounter. The focus becomes a comparator: exact cosmic alignment is immediate, while human arrival accumulates toil and marks.

activation_trace.role: Staged nurture and completion supply the common destination against which cosmic and human trajectories can be compared.
Exact fitting supplies the cosmic endpoint and functions as the low-friction alignment contrasted with toil.
The repeated completing Lord-relation directly links the human route to the focus relation.
Arduous work supplies the human route's friction and functions as the contrast to receptive cosmic yielding.
A scratch or bite-mark supplies the residue of toil and makes the contrast bodily rather than merely temporal.
Two things arriving face to face supplies encounter and functions as the human endpoint corresponding to cosmic fit.

structural_cues: The direct address to the human follows the two cosmic response sequences.
The same possessive Lord construction occurs in the focus and in 84:6.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one Lord, cosmic fulfillment, arduous marked striving, and encounter; I infer a comparative scale in which the focus models immediate alignment. The alternative is that both passages state obedience without contrasting their modes.

changed_reading.before: The focus is only a report about a cosmic subject.
changed_reading.after: The focus also models frictionless completed alignment against which the human's scar-making movement toward the same Lord is measured.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later record, accounting, return, Lordly sight, and uncut recompense turn حُقَّتْ into more than generic necessity. It marks a due claim embedded in an order where acts are fixed, examined, returned to their agent, and recompensed.

activation_trace.role: Fixed obligation supplies the juridical center and functions as the due claim later procedures administer.
A right possessed by its holder supplies claim-specificity and prevents due-ness from remaining impersonal fate.
A written fixation that entails judgment supplies the durable record and functions as the claim's documentary form.
Counting and reckoning supply the procedure by which the fixed claim is assessed.
Return and diminution supply the disputed consequence and function as the movement back into account.
Inner discernment supplies penetrating oversight and grounds the account beyond visible evidence alone.
Recompense for work supplies the positive settlement and functions as payment of the established due.
Cutting and diminishing an extension supply the negated limit, so the settled recompense is not exhausted or curtailed.

structural_cues: 84:7 and 84:10 pair two receptions of a record with opposed outcomes.
The denial of return in 84:14 is answered by the Lord's sight in 84:15.
The closing exception names work and recompense, completing the account sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies due-right branches, a judgment-bearing record, reckoning, return, oversight, and recompense; I infer that one juridical order connects cosmic due-ness to human account. The alternative is that حُقَّتْ remains an obedience idiom with no legal carryover.

changed_reading.before: The final focus verb says only that obedience was appropriate or inevitable.
changed_reading.after: The final focus verb inaugurates a world of enforceable due claims in which even cosmic response belongs to the same order as record, return, and recompense.

context_deltas.mechanism: Twilight, night-gathering, lunar completion, superposition, and stage after stage recast the focus as phase responsiveness. The subject listens by entering the next ordered state, and حُقَّتْ names exact articulation at the joint between layers rather than only obedience at an instant.

activation_trace.role: Completion by stages supplies the developmental regulator of the phase sequence.
An exact joint or socket supplies articulation and functions as the fit between successive states.
Arrival at full bodily condition supplies maturation and functions as phase completion.
The red afterglow at sunset supplies a threshold state and begins the ordered temporal transition.
Gathering dispersed things supplies the night's aggregating phase and functions as preparation for completion.
Complete, even ordering supplies the attained phase and directly strengthens the focus's completion model.
The moon and its light provide the body whose visible fullness makes ordered completion perceptible.
One thing mounted over another supplies superposition and functions as movement through layered states.
Condition after condition supplies explicit succession and turns listening into phase-sensitive transition.
Striking the joint or socket supplies a precise cross-root resonance with the focus and functions as exact phase articulation.

structural_cues: 84:16-18 presents an oath sequence of twilight, gathering night, and an ordered moon.
84:19 immediately names passage through one layer or state after another.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies temporal thresholds, gathering, completion, superposition, stages, and matching socket images; I infer that the focus describes responsiveness to an ordered phase change. The alternative is that the oath sequence illustrates human change only and does not revise the earlier cosmic hearing.

changed_reading.before: The subject obeys a single command at a single moment.
changed_reading.after: The subject listens by crossing an ordered threshold and fitting exactly into the next layer of a staged cosmic process.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later recipients encounter recitation yet do not lower themselves; they cover and deny. Against that refusal, the focus's hearing becomes embodied uptake: true reception alters the hearer's posture or form and makes truth manifest.

activation_trace.role: Accepting hearing supplies the positive reception against which later exposure without submission is measured.
Establishing and displaying truth supplies the result of genuine uptake and functions as enacted verification.
Reading and recitation supply an audible address and create the later test case for hearing.
Lowering and submission supply the missing bodily consequence and define what failed reception would have produced.
Bending the head supplies visible postural change and sharpens the contrast with the sky's form-changing answer.
Covering truth supplies the blocking mechanism that prevents heard address from becoming manifest response.
Attributing falsehood supplies active rejection and functions as the verbal inverse of accepting hearing.

structural_cues: 84:20 asks why the hearers do not trust, and 84:21 pairs recitation with absent prostration.
84:22 explains the absent bodily response through covering and denial.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recitation, refused lowering, covering, denial, and the focus's receptive branch; I infer that valid hearing must become bodily or formal response. The alternative is that prostration is an independent command and does not define the semantics of the earlier hearing.

changed_reading.after: Listening is completed only when reception passes into posture and form; the sky hears because it changes, while deniers remain acoustically exposed but unreceptive.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later imperative to announce an affectively inverted message activates the notification branch of the focus's first root. The focus can therefore carry two directions at once: the sky receives its Lord's summons and, through its altered surface, publicly announces the due reality.

activation_trace.role: Knowing and public notification supply the outward direction and function as the sky's proclamation through event.
Making truth established and visible supplies the proclamation's content and functions as public verification.
News that normally opens the skin with joy supplies announcement as an event on a surface; its painful inversion shows that the function can survive a reversed affect.
First signs or advance indications supply the heraldic timing and let the opening cosmic event function as an initial notice.

structural_cues: The surah opens with a visible cosmic event and later issues an explicit command to announce.
The announcement in 84:24 reverses expected good affect while retaining the act of notification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a public-notification branch, manifestation of truth, and an ironic announcement; I infer a macro-level echo in which the sky's response also broadcasts. The alternative is that the late imperative has no backward activation and the focus remains reception only.

changed_reading.before: The sky only receives a summons from its Lord.
changed_reading.after: The sky both receives and heralds: its changed surface publicly announces that the due reality has arrived.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the physical ear as an ear-like handle and combines it with container images rather than reading hearing psychologically. It remains anchored in the focus's first and final roots and is reinforced by contextual emptying and containment. Downstream prose should call it a material analogy, not a lexical replacement for listening or a claim that the sky is literally a pot.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The first focus root includes an ear-like appendage, the Lord-relation can mark an owner, and the final root includes a fitted socket or small container.

activation_trace.role: The bodily ear and ear-like handle supply a graspable appendage and function as the material analogue of receptivity.
Ownership supplies the vessel-owner relation and keeps the analogy tied to لِرَبِّهَا.
A fitted socket or container supplies exact placement and functions as the vessel's due setting.
Casting contents outward supplies the vessel-like act of discharge.
Becoming empty supplies the post-discharge state and extends the material analogy across the paired cosmic bodies.
Holding a thing in a vessel supplies the inverse operation and makes containment versus release a live surah-wide mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The sky is personified as a hearer who obeys.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the sky behaves like a handled vessel under its owner: receptivity means opening, releasing what is held, and settling into its fitting place.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant ر ب و mapping for the focus root and must not displace the dominant Lord reading. It remains valid as a packet-supplied split activation anchored directly in لِرَبِّهَا and gains coherence from height and later completion. Downstream prose should present it as a secondary sound-root activation about raising and maturation, not as the verse's morphology.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The packet maps the focus root ر ب ب not only to lordship but also, non-dominantly, to ر ب و branches of increase, height, and growth.

activation_trace.role: Increase and rising supply the non-dominant vertical activation and function as a secondary echo within the Lord-relation.
Feeding and growth supply maturation and let lordly completion be imagined as raising the cosmic body to readiness.
A creature reaching full condition supplies the endpoint and functions as maturity before transition.
Height and elevation supply the context's vertical body and reinforce the secondary rising image.
Completion and evenness supply a later phase analogue and function as confirmation of reached readiness.

changed_reading.before: The Lord-relation signifies sovereignty and command alone.
changed_reading.after: As a contained secondary activation, the Lord-relation also evokes raising and maturation: the elevated body reaches fullness and then yields into its next state.

strongest_changes: The preceding split makes the sky's physical opening readable as its act of receptive hearing.
The exact earth refrain generalizes hearing into geometric yielding, ejection, vacancy, and discharge of what is due.
The twilight-to-layer sequence turns due-ness into exact phase fitting, with a direct joint-and-socket resonance between ح ق ق and ط ب ق.
Recitation without prostration shows that focus-hearing is embodied uptake, while the late announcement activates the sky as both receiver and herald.
summary.what_was_special: The focus supported several mechanisms without forced merger: authoritative obedience, formative exact fit, covenantal assent, juridical due-ness, phase transition, embodied reception, and public notification. The most unusual live images were material discharge from a handled vessel and maturation through the packet's non-dominant split mapping.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal direction between opening and hearing remains live: opening may enact reception, follow reception, or merely stand beside it.
The declaration and announcement activations are branch-backed but more form-distant than receptive hearing.
The socket, vessel, and non-dominant growth images should remain analogical or secondary rather than replace the dominant syntax and root mappings.
